name: AI B-roll
honestScope: A hybrid B-roll workflow that turns script lines into candidate generated clips and can be paired with user-owned or permitted stock media.
gaps: Does not include a licensed stock-media catalog
Search, rights metadata, and asset delivery need application integrations
Generation cost and duration depend on the selected Muapi models
externalDependencies: Permitted stock-media source when using stock footage
notes: Potential future flagship demo for combining Muapi generation with an external media source.
